title: Urban Attractivity Index Netherlands
descriptions: The Urban Attractivity Index gives the degree of urban attractivity based on the weighted sum of the amount of shopping services, meeting and accommodation services, and monumentality in the vicinity per hectare. It is based on the January 1, 2018 version of the BAG (Basisregistratie Adressen en Gebouwen).
